en: Black‑and‑white photograph of an industrial harbor. In the foreground lies a medium-sized cargo vessel moored alongside the quay. Behind the ship are rail wagons loaded with bulk material and large piles of coal or similar cargo. Industrial buildings, silos and loading structures with cranes dominate the background, with a townscape faintly visible on a hill beyond. Part of a large word painted on a structure along the quay reads "IBELIUS".
